_doc: Finance (31) rule register seed — generated by devtools/gen_rules_seed.py from FINANCE_SPEC §B.12 and §H (rev 1, Sep 26 2026). Do not edit by hand: the SHA-256 is pinned.

rows.statement: Until Andre approves a Finance rule version every action is refused RULES_NOT_IN_FORCE.
rows.title: No action without an Andre-approved rule version

rows.statement: No journal entry carries lines of both ZBC and ZBM; restricted cash (1020/1040/1041) never funds operating expenses, ZBM or intercompany payables.
rows.title: Entities never mix; restricted cash never pays opex or ZBM

rows.statement: Every entry balances (debits = credits), has two or more lines in one entity's chart, is never updated or deleted; a mistake gets a reversing entry. Trial balance per entity is 0.00 after every append.
rows.title: Double entry, balance to zero, append-only, reverse never edit

rows.statement: Money is decimal.Decimal, on the wire a canonical two-decimal string; views x rate / 1000 is exact and quantized half-up once per payable.
rows.title: Money: Decimal, two-decimal strings, one HALF_UP quantize per payable

rows.statement: A payable is accrued only from a V&I certification (certified/revised) read by Finance and an allowed Compliance payout ruling for that submission; no caller ever supplies a count or an amount.
rows.title: Payable only from a V&I certified count and an allowed Compliance payout ruling

rows.statement: The creator rate is the latest Andre-published rate card version for the campaign effective at the clip's posting time (CN-17).
rows.title: Rate = Andre-published rate card effective at posting time

rows.statement: A certification whose revenue amount exceeds the campaign's remaining unearned deposit posts nothing and waits for Andre (top-up invoice, operating top-up, or refusal).
rows.title: Accrual beyond remaining deposit goes to over_budget_hold for Andre

rows.statement: The system proposes a payout batch; only Andre approves it, by quoting its content_sha256; the approver cannot release and no caller can approve.
rows.title: Maker-checker: Andre's token on the batch content_sha256

rows.statement: Every release gate (certification, Compliance, tax, OFAC, rail, holds, minimum, limits, reconciliation, treasury, controls, rules) re-runs at release; an absent, stale or stand-in input fails its gate.
rows.title: Release gates, all re-evaluated at release

rows.statement: The rail idempotency key is SHA-256(zbc|payout|batch|payee|period); a payable appears in at most one payout item that is not failed, cancelled or excluded at release; after 23 h a rail retry becomes a lookup.
rows.title: Idempotency key batch+payee+period; a payable in at most one live item

rows.statement: A payee whose net is below FIN_MIN_PAYOUT is carried forward to the next run (not an error).
rows.title: Net below the minimum payout carries forward

rows.statement: W-9 on file with TIN matched, or W-8 current with the outside-US attestation; anything else blocks (policy block). No TIN is ever stored by Finance.
rows.title: Tax gate before the first dollar

rows.statement: A flagged payee is paid gross less 24% withheld (credited to 2040); CP2100 intake starts the 15 / 30 business day B-notice timers; an overdue timer blocks runs.
rows.title: Backup withholding 24% when flagged; B-notice timers

rows.statement: A payee (and each 25%+ owner of an entity payee) needs a clear Compliance screen at most FIN_OFAC_MAX_AGE_DAYS old on the current list version at release.
rows.title: OFAC: fresh clear screen at release

rows.statement: A payout destination change puts the payee on hold; only an Andre callback to the contact on file (never one supplied in the request) lifts it, after FIN_PAYEE_CHANGE_COOLING_OFF_H.
rows.title: Destination change: hold, callback to the number on file, cooling-off

rows.statement: Per-payee per-run, rolling 30-day, first-payout, per-batch and item-count limits; over a limit the payee goes to the exception queue for Andre.
rows.title: Velocity and exposure limits go to the exception queue, never silently

rows.statement: Clawbacks are netted against future earnings; a write-off needs Andre and FIN_CLAWBACK_WRITEOFF_MIN_DAYS; no route debits a creator's external account.
rows.title: Clawback only by netting; write-off only by Andre; never a pull

rows.statement: Every leg must match to the cent; a difference opens a break; any open break or a stale run blocks payout runs, releases, sweeps and refunds.
rows.title: Daily reconciliation, zero tolerance; an open break blocks runs and sweeps

rows.statement: 1020 + 1040 + 1041 >= 2010 + 2020 + 2030 + 2040 + 2050 + 2070, on the journal and on independent balances.
rows.title: Restricted pool covers creator-and-client liabilities, always

rows.statement: V&I certifies and cannot release; the scheduler proposes and releases and cannot approve; Andre approves and cannot release; rate cards and rules are Andre-only.
rows.title: Separation of duties by caller identity

rows.statement: Andre attests who holds which token; overdue blocks runs and releases.
rows.title: Access (token roster) review every FIN_ACCESS_REVIEW_DAYS

rows.statement: No invoice line is a surcharge, card fee, convenience fee or processing fee; card costs are priced into rate cards.
rows.title: No surcharge; no card-fee line

rows.statement: A subscription or retainer invoice needs every recurring field (consent artifact, cancellation medium, annual reminder, price-change notice, trial reminder) and US-ROSCA in force.
rows.title: Recurring billing only with ARL/ROSCA mechanics

rows.statement: An open dispute pauses the campaign's accruals and freezes refunds on it.
rows.title: Disputes freeze refunds; evidence pack at settlement

rows.statement: Reportable payments per payee per tax year (America/Los_Angeles release date) are tracked against the year's threshold (2026: 2000.00) only while US-IRS-1099NEC is in force.
rows.title: 1099-NEC tracker, IRIS channel, FTB filing

rows.statement: A locked period accepts no posting; corrections post in the open period with reverses_entry_id.
rows.title: Five-workday close; closed periods locked

rows.statement: QBO receives a copy; it never drives Finance.
rows.title: GL is downstream; the journal is the source of truth

rows.statement: Each FIN-CQ row blocks what it names until Andre approves a memo row.
rows.title: Counsel/CPA rows block what they name

rows.statement: Bank details live at the rail only; Finance keeps opaque references and hashes.
rows.title: No bank, card, TIN, SSN or DOB data stored

rows.statement: ZBC holds its own customer deposits in 'ZBC Client Campaign Deposits'; the words escrow, trust, FBO and 'for the benefit of' are refused in account titles, invoice lines and template variables.
rows.title: Principal model; account titled per R5; banned custody words

rows.statement: A payee whose rail cannot reach the country, whose rail account is not verified with payouts enabled, or whose country is not operate/conditional at Compliance is not payable.
rows.title: Rail reach and Compliance jurisdiction

rows.statement: Counsel/CPA question (spec §H): Model A deposit: customer deposit vs trust/fiduciary under California law. Blocks: campaign fundable.
rows.title: Model A deposit: customer deposit vs trust/fiduciary under California law

rows.statement: Counsel/CPA question (spec §H): Third-party custody (FBO, DFPI escrow agent, Stripe funds segregation). Blocks: custody model other than own_deposit.
rows.title: Third-party custody (FBO, DFPI escrow agent, Stripe funds segregation)

rows.statement: Counsel/CPA question (spec §H): ASC 606 principal-versus-agent memo; gross vs net. Blocks: close finalization.
rows.title: ASC 606 principal-versus-agent memo; gross vs net

rows.statement: Counsel/CPA question (spec §H): Accounting for clawbacks and any administrative hold on unspent budget. Blocks: close finalization; admin fee > 0.
rows.title: Accounting for clawbacks and any administrative hold on unspent budget

rows.statement: Counsel/CPA question (spec §H): Contractual restriction as restricted cash; current or noncurrent. Blocks: close finalization.
rows.title: Contractual restriction as restricted cash; current or noncurrent

rows.statement: Counsel/CPA question (spec §H): Year-one TIN matching route; unmatched W-9 withholding posture. Blocks: withhold_24 policy.
rows.title: Year-one TIN matching route; unmatched W-9 withholding posture

rows.statement: Counsel/CPA question (spec §H): AB 5 classification of clippers. Blocks: nothing extra (Compliance blocks payouts).
rows.title: AB 5 classification of clippers

rows.statement: Counsel/CPA question (spec §H): Days-in-the-US allocation for foreign clippers. Blocks: nothing extra.
rows.title: Days-in-the-US allocation for foreign clippers

rows.statement: Counsel/CPA question (spec §H): Civ. Code 1748.1 reach to B2B; surviving late fee. Blocks: late fees; any card acceptance.
rows.title: Civ. Code 1748.1 reach to B2B; surviving late fee

rows.statement: Counsel/CPA question (spec §H): ARL scope for small-business subscribers; consent/cancel artifacts. Blocks: subscription/retainer invoices.
rows.title: ARL scope for small-business subscribers; consent/cancel artifacts

rows.statement: Counsel/CPA question (spec §H): California sales tax on ZBC/ZBM deliverables; nexus. Blocks: invoice issuance (both entities).
rows.title: California sales tax on ZBC/ZBM deliverables; nexus

rows.statement: Counsel/CPA question (spec §H): UCC 4A loss allocation under the bank security procedure. Blocks: FC-12 stays red.
rows.title: UCC 4A loss allocation under the bank security procedure

rows.statement: Counsel/CPA question (spec §H): Direct ACH origination obligations. Blocks: direct ACH rail.
rows.title: Direct ACH origination obligations

rows.statement: Counsel/CPA question (spec §H): FDIC custodial-account recordkeeping; pass-through insurance for FBO. Blocks: FBO custody model.
rows.title: FDIC custodial-account recordkeeping; pass-through insurance for FBO

rows.statement: Counsel/CPA question (spec §H): DAC7/UK/Canada platform-operator status. Blocks: nothing extra.
rows.title: DAC7/UK/Canada platform-operator status
